messages.subject: Part 4 ID issue
parts:
Hello,
I am having trouble getting GGIR to recognize IDs consistently, which is leading to problems with part 4 and integrating sleep logs. I am using Axivity OMGUI to collect data which outputs files in the format deviceID_subjectID.cwa (example, 67067_0000000131.cwa). Initially I used idloc=6, which should give “67067_0000000131” as the ID. This works for part 2 and part 5 output, which have “67067_0000000131” in the ID column.

However, for part 4 output, the ID column is “67067,” and for the summary csv, all subjects using this device ID have been collapsed into the same subject. Further, part 4 is only able to match sleep log data when I use “67067” in the ID column, which is problematic because this device ID isn’t specific to the subject. Is there a way to get around this issue?

I'd appreciate any help, thanks very much!
Joe

Hello Joe,
Thanks for reporting this. Looks like it is a bug.
It may take a couple of weeks before this is fixed.
Thanks,
Vincent
